metadata.title: hyperCAD-S Drawing Operations - Complete Enumeration
metadata.description: Exhaustive parameter catalog for hyperCAD-S 2D Drawing workspace. Drawings are 2D-from-3D outputs for shop-floor documentation, fabrication prints, and inspection plans. Six categories: 6 view ops (Projection / Auxiliary / Section / Detail / Broken-Out / Crop), 8 annotation ops (Linear / Angular / Radius / Diameter / Chamfer dims + Note / Symbol / GD&T-Frame), 1 hatch op, 3 table ops (Title-Block / Revision-Table / BOM-Table), and 3 style ops (Layer / Linetype / Plot-Style). Section view supports full / half / aligned / offset / broken sub-types. GD&T frame supports the 14 ASME Y14.5 / ISO 1101 symbols.
metadata.source: OPEN MIND hyperCAD-S Drawing Reference, ASME Y14.5-2018, ISO 1101:2017

commonTabs.description: Standard parameter tabs across hyperCAD-S drawing operations

VIEW_PROJECTION.description: Standard orthographic projection view of a 3D model. Auto-aligns child views (top / right / iso) to a chosen base view per first-angle or third-angle convention.

parameters.name: Source Body
parameters.description: 3D body / assembly to project

parameters.name: Configuration
parameters.description: Configuration name when source has multiple

parameters.name: User Direction
parameters.description: View direction (View Type = user_defined)

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: View scale factor (e.g. 1, 0.5, 2, 'sheet')

VIEW_AUXILIARY.description: Auxiliary view projected normal to a selected edge / face. Used to show inclined features in true size.

parameters.name: Parent View
parameters.description: View on which the projector edge / face was selected

parameters.name: Projector Reference
parameters.description: Edge or face whose normal becomes the auxiliary projection direction

parameters.name: Distance From Parent
parameters.description: Auxiliary view offset on sheet

parameters.name: Inherit Scale
parameters.description: Use parent view's scale (default) vs override per-view

VIEW_SECTION.description: Section view cut by a plane / step / aligned cutter. Five sub-types cover full / half / aligned / offset / broken sectioning.

parameters.name: Section Line
parameters.description: Sketch line / chained edges defining the cut path

parameters.name: Show Section Line
parameters.description: Draw cutting-plane line on parent view with end arrows

parameters.name: Section Label
parameters.description: Letter pair (e.g. 'A-A')

VIEW_DETAIL.description: Magnified detail view of a region on a parent view. Boundary may be circular or freeform polygon.

parameters.name: Center Point
parameters.description: Center of detail region (Boundary Type = circle)

parameters.name: Radius
parameters.description: Circle radius on parent view (Boundary Type = circle)

parameters.name: Polygon Vertices
parameters.description: Boundary polygon vertices (Boundary Type = polygon)

parameters.name: Magnification
parameters.description: Detail scale relative to parent (e.g. 2 = 2× larger)

VIEW_BROKEN_OUT.description: Broken-out section — local cut into a parent view, exposing internal features without splitting the whole view. Boundary closes the cut region back to outer geometry.

parameters.name: Boundary Sketch
parameters.description: Closed sketch on parent view defining cut boundary

parameters.name: Cut Depth
parameters.description: Cut depth (Cut Depth Mode = by_distance)

parameters.name: Reference Plane
parameters.description: Cut-to plane (Cut Depth Mode = to_plane)

VIEW_CROP.description: Crop view to a closed boundary — hides view geometry outside the crop while keeping references intact.

parameters.name: Crop Boundary
parameters.description: Closed sketch defining the crop region

parameters.name: Show Crop Boundary
parameters.description: Draw crop boundary as a phantom line

DIM_LINEAR.description: Linear dimension between two points / two edges / parallel features. Supports tolerance display, fits, and reference dimension styling.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: Dimension line position on the sheet

parameters.name: Override Value
parameters.description: Force a value different from the measured (use sparingly)

parameters.name: Reference Dimension
parameters.description: Display in parentheses, non-driving

DIM_ANGULAR.description: Angular dimension between two non-parallel edges / lines. Supports acute / obtuse / reflex angle selection.

DIM_RADIUS.description: Radius dimension on a circular arc. Auto-prefixes 'R' per ASME / ISO drawing standards.

DIM_DIAMETER.description: Diameter dimension on a circle / cylindrical edge. Auto-prefixes 'Ø' per ASME / ISO.

DIM_CHAMFER.description: Chamfer dimension — distance × angle or two-distance form per drawing standard.

NOTE.description: Free-text note with optional leader. Supports parametric placeholders (e.g. revision, part number) resolved at plot time.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: Note text (supports {{revision}}, {{part_no}} placeholders)

parameters.name: Anchor Reference
parameters.description: Optional leader anchor (face / edge / point)

SYMBOL.description: Insert a drafting symbol (surface-finish symbol, weld symbol, datum target, datum-feature symbol). Symbol library follows ASME Y14.36M / Y14.5.

parameters.name: Anchor Reference
parameters.description: Edge / face / point the symbol is attached to

parameters.name: Annotation Text
parameters.description: Symbol-specific text (e.g. surface-finish Ra value, datum letter, weld designation)

GDT_FRAME.description: Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing frame per ASME Y14.5-2018 / ISO 1101:2017. Supports the 14 standard symbols across form / orientation / location / runout / profile categories.

parameters.name: Anchor Reference
parameters.description: Feature on which the GD&T frame is placed

parameters.name: Datum 1
parameters.description: Primary datum letter (A..Z)

parameters.name: Datum 2
parameters.description: Secondary datum letter

parameters.name: Datum 3
parameters.description: Tertiary datum letter

HATCHING.description: Apply a hatch pattern to a closed boundary. Standard library includes ANSI31 (steel), ANSI32 (cast iron), ANSI33 (bronze), ANSI37 (lead), and user-defined.

parameters.name: Boundary
parameters.description: Closed boundary curves / faces

parameters.name: Background Color
parameters.description: Optional background fill color (hex / named)

TITLE_BLOCK.description: Insert / update the sheet title block. Fields auto-populate from drawing properties (part number, revision, scale, drawer, date) and accept manual overrides.

parameters.name: Template Path
parameters.description: Path to title-block template file (.dwt / company-standard)

parameters.name: Custom Position
parameters.description: Sheet coordinates (Position = custom)

parameters.name: Field Overrides
parameters.description: Per-field override map (key = field id, value = string)

parameters.name: Auto Update Revision
parameters.description: Pull revision from drawing-properties on every save

REVISION_TABLE.description: Revision history table. Auto-populates from version-control / PDM hooks and supports manual entry for shop-floor markups.

parameters.name: Columns
parameters.description: Visible columns (rev, date, description, drawer, approver, ECN)

BOM_TABLE.description: Bill-of-Materials table on the drawing sheet. Pulls from the assembly's BOM_EXTRACT output and groups linked instances per row.

parameters.name: Columns
parameters.description: Visible columns (item_no, qty, part_no, description, material, vendor)

parameters.name: Auto Balloon Items
parameters.description: Auto-place balloons on referenced views matching item numbers

LAYER.description: Define a drawing layer with name, color, linetype, and visibility. Layers control plot output and on/off display.

parameters.name: Color
parameters.description: Hex / named color (e.g. '#000000', 'red')

parameters.name: Lineweight
parameters.description: Print line weight

parameters.name: Plottable
parameters.description: Include layer in plot output

LINETYPE.description: Define a custom linetype with dash / gap pattern. Standard linetypes (continuous / dashed / centerline / phantom) are pre-defined.

parameters.name: Pattern
parameters.description: Alternating dash / gap lengths in mm (e.g. [5, 2, 1, 2])

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Human-readable description shown in linetype picker

PLOT_STYLE.description: Define a plot style table mapping screen colors / layers to printed output (line weight, screening, end style).

parameters.name: Forced Line Weight
parameters.description: Line weight override (Line Weight Mode = force_value)

parameters.name: Screening
parameters.description: Print intensity 0..100 (100 = full opacity)

platform_notes.view_first: Recommended workflow: VIEW_PROJECTION (front) → child views (top / right / iso) by VIEW_PROJECTION on the same sheet → annotations. SECTION / DETAIL / BROKEN_OUT views require a parent view and a sketch boundary.
platform_notes.gdt_standard: GDT_FRAME enumerates the 14 ASME Y14.5-2018 / ISO 1101:2017 symbols. Material-condition modifiers (MMC / LMC / RFS) follow ASME convention.
platform_notes.title_block_template: Title-block content is template-driven — company-standard templates enforce field layout while individual fields auto-populate from drawing-properties on every save.
